contexts.text: The prolification of falsity from evil thence. Signified.
All its fibres regard the Prolific of the seed... It then serves the Prolific as soil... The Prolific in plants corresponds to the good in man. Explained.
The Prolific remains in its integrity, and produces a new plant...
From this is the Prolific (of seeds).
The state up to the time of prolification...
(Sexual intercourse there is) without prolification, instead of which there is spiritual prolification. Explained. CL 52.
The Prolific is in the male. This is from no other source than the understanding; being from truth from good there.
A sphere of propagation, that is, of prolification and fructification...
The Prolific of the husband would be in a continual Spring... The spiritual prolifications with the Angels are such; and... natural prolifications also are from this origin.
Prolification corresponds to the propagation of truth.

The prolific contributions from husbands are received universally by wives, and add themselves to their life... Because in the Prolific of the husband is his soul, and also his mind as to its interiors...
All fructification, propagation, and prolification, are originally from the influx of love, wisdom, and use from the Lord...
The faculty of prolificating in males, which makes a one with the faculty of multiplying wisdom from the love of truth.
Like the Prolific of the seed...
There is some correspondence of Heaven with the prolification in adulteries; but not with the delight in them.
From this love descends the love of prolificating... From this love descends the love of prolificating in adulteries...
Conjugial love begins... to inspire sports for the sake of prolification.
Marriages are seminaries for Heaven through prolifications.
